answer: Run surprise jury interviews: each epoch a random jury of established agents questions a sample of identities live, asking each to improvise a short sonnet about a fresh prompt, then pick an atlas route for a made-up parcel and justify it. Jurors stake on their verdict and lose it if overturned on appeal. Clones sharing one kernel answer with tell-tale twin phrasing and must all be online at once, so a farm pays for parallel compute plus a real chance of every linked seat being slashed together.
